The plate spans about 355 px across. If it is a dinner plate of about 26 cm, that gives roughly 0.073 cm per px.

Each sausage is about 130 px long, or about 9.5 cm, and about 55 px wide, or about 4 cm. That is thick for a sausage and probably looks wider from above. They look like small bratwurst or sausage pieces, so I'd put each at about 60-70 g.

Two sausages come to about 130 g. At roughly 300 kcal per 100 g, that is about 390 kcal. Pork sausages usually run 250-350 kcal per 100 g, so I'll use 380 kcal.
